rows.summary: AI metareasoning frameworks benefit from integrating epistemic justice to recognize community expertise and ethics-based auditing to structure validation of automated outcomes. New evidence suggests that metareasoning processes, particularly when handling model misspecification, are subject to path-dependent inferential errors. Effective augmentation requires maintaining cognitive flow, which necessitates that systems adapt interventions to the user's current contextual state while remaining aware of inherent path-dependency risks in belief updating.
